answer.rationale: Do not counter with promotional pricing: the recovered experiment for the same price-sensitive SMB segment showed strong acquisition but 30-day retention declined 12%, making discounting inconsistent with sustainable qualified revenue and risking price-conditioning. Deploy targeted in-product activation messaging to at-risk SMB accounts as a guarded retention intervention; it has demonstrated improvement in week-one engagement and first meaningful action, but has not yet established churn reduction under competitor price pressure.
